content: FastAPI current stable is 0.139.0 (July 1 2026, verified via pypi.org). UploadFile is preferred over bytes for large files (streams instead of buffering in memory). python-multipart (0.0.32) is a required separate dependency for Form/File parsing since starlette stopped bundling it. Validate content by magic bytes not just extension/content-type header (client-controlled, spoofable).
